# BaseHalf 0.7.2 - Comments on PDFs, Books, and Notes, One Reader, and a Zoom for Each Part

This release lets you mark what you read. Highlight a passage of a PDF or a book, or comment on a passage of a PDF, a book, or a note, and your agents can read your comments and answer them. PDFs and books now open in one reader of BaseHalf's own, and the keys that zoom change only the part you are working in.

## Comments and Highlights

- **From the selection.** Select text in a PDF or a book and choose Highlight, Comment, Grow branch, or Copy. A highlight colors the passage. A comment draws a wavy line under it and keeps your words on a small sticky note beside it, folded to a mark until you point at it or open it.
- **Notes take comments too**, on their text in the Rich view of Card Detail.
- In a PDF, a comment can also be stuck on a place of a page.
- **The Comments panel** at the right lists every highlight and comment of the document.
- **Your agents read and answer them.** Highlights and comments are kept beside the file as text, never in it: a PDF or a book keeps its bytes, and a note's Markdown holds no comment. Agents read them and write comments and replies through BaseHalf's skill, and what they write shows at once.

## PDFs and Books

- **One reader for both.** The header of Card Detail is its only bar, with Sidebar, Find, and Comments. The panel at the left holds Pages and Contents. A PDF's page and zoom, or a book's place and text size, stand at the bottom left, where the canvas keeps its zoom.
- A PDF is one column of pages that the wheel or a two-finger scroll moves, and a press in text selects. The viewer's hand and pointer tools, its own menu, and its page settings are gone.
- **Find** opens at the top right and matches whatever the case, the accents, full-width or half-width forms, and the quotation marks. In a PDF it finds a word that a hyphen broke over two lines and a phrase across a line break. It waits while an input method composes, as for Chinese.
- Cmd+= and Cmd+- zoom the PDF or the book's text, never the window.

## Zoom

- **Each part zooms by itself.** Cmd+= and Cmd+- zoom the part that has the keyboard: the canvas, the Agent Area's text, a PDF, or a book's text, and anywhere else the window. Cmd+0 goes back to 100% on the canvas, in the Agent Area, and in a PDF.
- **The window's zoom leaves the cards and the Agent Area's text as they are.** It makes Files, the bars, the menus, Settings, and Card Detail larger or smaller, while the cards keep their size on the screen and the canvas's zoom still says what it said. Before, Cmd+= in the Agent Area zoomed the whole window, cards included.
- Larger Agent Area Text, Smaller Agent Area Text, Reset Agent Area Text Size, and Zoom Reader In, Out, and to 100% are commands that Keyboard Shortcuts lists, so you can give them other keys.

## Agent Area

- **Connected tabs**, drawn as VS Code 1.147 draws the tabs of its panel: each as wide as its name, the active one opening into its session.

## Notes

- A note opened in Card Detail keeps the keyboard in its editor, with the caret where it was, also when the window takes the focus away for a moment as the note opens.

## New Installs

Download the DMG, drag BaseHalf into Applications, then run this once before first launch:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/BaseHalf.app
```

The app is not Apple-notarized yet. The update payload is protected by BaseHalf's signed update manifest and archive verification.
